faq.question: What is the CAS number and form supplied?

faq.question: Why is no single molecular weight quoted?
faq.answer: Hyaluronic acid is polydisperse: it has a molecular-weight distribution rather than one exact mass. The batch COA states the measured range for that lot; we do not quote an invented single figure.

faq.question: Is this a cosmetic or injectable product?
